subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be allowed to install or reuse process-wide plugins under the displayed exact-plan consent model, or should this slice be limited to workspace-scoped skills until a host-level grant model is approved?
rationale: The patch intentionally treats plugins as shared-host resources rather than per-agent resources; that is a user-visible authority boundary that tests and contributor discussion cannot settle without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the shared-host v1 model
options.body: Accept process-wide plugin installation/reuse under exact-plan consent, then require exact-head redacted proof of install, reuse, and safe compensation before merge.

options.title: Limit this slice to skills
options.body: Keep workspace-scoped skill installation and defer shared-plugin mutation until a separate host-grant or isolation design is accepted.

options.title: Pause package mutation
options.body: Defer both package paths while the broader Claws RFC and lifecycle stack receives maintainer product review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared-host v1 model
recommendation.body: Accept process-wide plugin installation/reuse under exact-plan consent, then require exact-head redacted proof of install, reuse, and safe compensation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their package-lifecycle review established the concrete consent, provenance, reuse, and uninstall invariants affected by this choice.
